meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 会去查 claude-mem 保存的跨会话记忆库,按「搜索索引 → 看时间线 → 只取相关条目的完整详情」的顺序回答上次做过什么,只在必要时才读工具原始输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问「这个问题以前解决过吗」「上次是怎么做 X 的」,或需要之前会话的工作内容时触发,而不是聊当前对话。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决认证问题的?
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的搜索结果表

say.text: 搜一下 my-project 里最近的 bugfix 记录
say.note: 只给索引列表,不拉全文

say.text: 把 11131 前后各 3 条时间线调出来
say.note: 看该条目周边的上下文

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: it runs a search index, checks the timeline, then fetches full details for chosen IDs, and only rarely pulls raw tool input/output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions — e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?" — or when work from earlier sessions is needed.

say_en.text: How did we fix the auth issue last time?
say_en.note: Returns a search results table with IDs

say_en.text: Search my-project for recent bugfix records
say_en.note: Returns an index list, no full details
Shows context before and after it
